title: The Holy Crown - A Szent Korona

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can name the parts of the Hungarian coronation regalia: the crown, the scepter, the orb and the mantle.
I can describe the Holy Crown's eventful modern history, including its return to Hungary in 1978.
I can explain what the Holy Crown symbolizes today: the continuity of Hungarian statehood.
I can combine participle titles with 'által' agent phrases, e.g. 'a pápa által küldött korona'.
I can connect Szent István's coronation to the founding of the Árpád royal dynasty that followed him.
